I had a very good experience at ClearSmile Dental Clinic. The whole team is incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the dentist is very gentle, careful and meticulous.

I’m usually quite nervous about injections, but I was honestly surprised because I barely felt anything. Everything was done very smoothly and with a lot of care.

The team also speaks English well and takes the time to explain every step of the treatment, which I really appreciate since I don’t speak Thai yet. It makes the whole experience much more reassuring and comfortable.

The prices are also very reasonable for the quality of care and service provided.

I would definitely recommend this clinic and will happily come back in the future.
